facts.label: Descrever e comparar
facts.sub: Use there is/are para dizer o que existe: There are many leaves. Use -er + than para comparar: The red ones are prettier than the yellow ones.

facts.label: Tem
facts.sub: Use there is para uma coisa e there are para várias: There is a bench. There are many leaves. Para perguntar, use Is there…? e Are there…? Responda Yes, there is ou No, there isn’t.

facts.label: Comparativos
facts.sub: Para comparar, adicione -er em adjetivos curtos e use than: older than, colder than, bigger than. Em adjetivos que terminam em y, vira -ier: prettier. Good vira better.

pages.title: A park in autumn · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool Sunday afternoon in a park in Dublin. The path is full of colorful leaves. Vera walks slowly with her scarf. Her friend Lia meets her near the pond. Some ducks swim in the water. Vera points at the trees.
“Look, Lia! There are so many leaves in the park.” says Vera. “Yes! There are red, yellow and brown leaves.” says Lia. “The red ones are prettier than the yellow ones.” says Vera.
